purpose: Describe the beginning of an activity or process.
keywords: I started learning Japanese last year.
The flowers have begun to bloom.
When the teacher began speaking, everyone became quiet.
restrictions: The compound can describe deliberate or natural onset; context supplies the actor’s control.
mistake: Attach to the stem rather than the dictionary form.

segments.role: Describe the beginning of an activity or process. ます-stem + 始める.
